Spiced Roasted Nuts

Served at: All Hallows' Eve (Halloween)

Serves 8Prep 10 minCook 20 min

Spiced roasted nuts are a popular snack during All Hallows' Eve, providing a warm, flavorful treat that complements the autumnal festivities. These nuts are often enjoyed while trick-or-treating or at Halloween parties, adding a cozy and slightly spicy touch to the celebration.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups (300 g) mixed nuts (such as almonds, pecans, walnuts, cashews)
  • 2 tablespoons (30 ml) unsalted butter, melted
  • 1 tablespoon (12 g) brown sugar
  • 1 teaspoon (2 g) ground cinnamon
  • 1/2 teaspoon (1 g) ground nutmeg
  • 1/2 teaspoon (1 g) smoked paprika
  • 1/4 teaspoon (1 g) cayenne pepper (optional, for heat)
  • 1 teaspoon (6 g) kosher salt

Method

  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
  2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the melted butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper (if using), and kosher salt.
  3. Add the mixed nuts to the bowl and toss well to coat evenly with the spiced butter mixture.
  4. Spread the nuts in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
  5. Roast the nuts in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, stirring once halfway through to ensure even roasting.
  6. Remove the nuts from the oven and let them cool completely on the baking sheet; they will become crispier as they cool.
  7. Once cooled, serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to one week.

Tips

  • Use your favorite combination of nuts or add seeds like pumpkin seeds for extra texture.
  • Adjust the cayenne pepper to control the level of spiciness, or omit it for a milder flavor.
  • For a sweeter version, increase the brown sugar slightly and add a pinch of ground cloves.
